evidence.quote: TPU7x is the first release within the Ironwood family, Google Cloud's seventh generation TPU.
Bidirectional inter-chip interconnect (ICI) bandwidth per chip (GBps) 1200 800 1200

notes.zh:
回答「第七代 TPU 单芯片给多少 HBM、FP8/BF16 算力，以及一个 Pod 有多大」。192GiB HBM3E、7.38TB/s、4614 TF FP8 是单芯片；9216 chips per pod 是 Pod 规模。它不是 GPU，不能按 CUDA 生态的选型逻辑直接套。
不主张：TPU 的 Pod 规模不是单卡可比的吞吐；4614 TF 是 FP8 峰值；不是所有框架都支持（官方写明 TensorFlow 不支持，JAX/PyTorch 支持）；不是「比 GPU 更强」的结论。
notes.en:
Answers per-chip HBM, FP8/BF16 compute and Pod size for the seventh-generation TPU. 192GiB HBM3E, 7.38TB/s and 4614 TF FP8 are per chip; 9,216 chips per Pod is the Pod footprint. It is not a GPU and cannot be slotted into CUDA-ecosystem selection logic.
It does not claim: Pod scale is not per-card throughput; 4614 TF is FP8 peak; not every framework is supported (the docs say TensorFlow is not supported, JAX/PyTorch are); it is not a claim that TPUs are stronger than GPUs.

evidence.quote: 432 GB integrated HBM4 Memory with up to 23.3 TB/s Peak Theoretical Memory Bandwidth

notes.zh:
回答「单卡 432GB HBM4 这一档的容量、带宽与 MXFP4 算力」。432GB 是目前公开单卡里最大的一档，12 个 HBM4 stack；对需要把超大模型或长 KV 缓存留在单卡上的场景，容量比峰值算力更先决定能不能跑。
不主张：40.3 PF 是 OCP MXFP4 峰值，不是实测；不能与 NVIDIA NVFP4 直接横比；不是 Helios 整机架的 2.9 EF FP4；DLC 意味着风冷机房不能直接上。
notes.en:
Answers capacity, bandwidth and MXFP4 compute at the 432GB HBM4 tier. 432GB is the largest publicly documented per-GPU figure here, with 12 HBM4 stacks; for keeping very large models or long KV caches on one card, capacity decides feasibility before peak compute.
It does not claim: 40.3 PF is OCP MXFP4 peak, not measured; it is not directly comparable with NVIDIA NVFP4; it is not Helios’ 2.9 EF FP4 rack figure; DLC means an air-cooled facility cannot simply take it.

evidence.quote: Rubin integrates up to 288 GB of HBM4 memory, driven by dedicated HBM controllers and 12-Hi stacks, to deliver up to 22 TB/s of peak bandwidth.
Its 336 billion transistors, 224 streaming multiprocessors (SMs), and 896 Tensor Cores
up to 50 petaflops of NVFP4 inference performance

notes.zh:
回答「Rubin 单卡把 HBM4 做到多少容量与带宽、NVFP4 推理给到多少」。288GB 与 B300 相同，但 HBM4 把带宽从 8 TB/s 拉到 22 TB/s，NVLink 6 从 1.8 TB/s 拉到 3.6 TB/s；这三项决定长上下文与高并发的实际上限。
不主张：50 PF 是 NVFP4 推理性能，不是所有精度；不能与 AMD MXFP4 数字直接横比；不是整机 Vera Rubin NVL72 的合计；不是实测吞吐。
notes.en:
Answers Rubin’s per-GPU HBM4 capacity and bandwidth, and its NVFP4 inference figure. 288GB matches B300, but HBM4 lifts bandwidth from 8 TB/s to 22 TB/s and NVLink 6 from 1.8 TB/s to 3.6 TB/s; those three set the practical ceiling for long context and concurrency.
It does not claim: 50 PF is NVFP4 inference performance, not every precision; it is not directly comparable with AMD MXFP4 figures; it is not the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack total; it is not measured throughput.

evidence.quote: delivers 15 petaFLOPS of dense NVFP4 compute through 640 fifth-generation Tensor Cores across 160 Streaming Multiprocessors
HBM3E memory capacity reaches 288 GB with 8 TB/s bandwidth
Max power (TGP) Up to 700W Up to 1,200W Up to 1,400W

notes.zh:
回答「Blackwell Ultra 单卡在 288GB 档给多少 dense NVFP4 与带宽」。15 PF 是 dense NVFP4，不是稀疏数字；8 TB/s 与 B200 同级，容量也一样是 288GB，差别在 NVFP4 算力与能效。
不主张：15 PF 不能与 Rubin 的 50 PF NVFP4 推理数字直接横比；不是整机 GB300 NVL72 的算力；1400W 是最高 TGP，实际功耗随负载与配置变化。
notes.en:
Answers what Blackwell Ultra offers at the 288GB tier in dense NVFP4 and bandwidth. 15 PF is dense NVFP4, not sparse; 8 TB/s matches B200, and capacity is also 288GB — the difference is NVFP4 compute and efficiency.
It does not claim: 15 PF is not directly comparable with Rubin’s 50 PF NVFP4 inference figure; it is not the GB300 NVL72 rack number; 1,400W is max TGP, and real power varies with workload and configuration.

notes.zh:
回答「288GB HBM4 这一档，AMD 的带宽与 MXFP4 算力给到多少」。与 MI455X 同为 CDNA5、同为 23.3 TB/s，但 MI455X 是 432GB / 12 stack，MI450X 是 288GB / 8 stack；型号差在容量，不在架构代际。
不主张：MXFP4 的 40.3 PF 不能与 NVIDIA 的 NVFP4 数字直接横比；不是实际训练吞吐；不是「比 MI455X 更强或更弱」的结论。
notes.en:
Answers what AMD offers at the 288GB HBM4 tier in bandwidth and MXFP4 compute. It shares CDNA5 and 23.3 TB/s with MI455X, but MI455X is 432GB / 12 stacks while MI450X is 288GB / 8 stacks; the difference is capacity, not architecture generation.
It does not claim: MXFP4 40.3 PF is not directly comparable with NVIDIA NVFP4 figures; it is not measured training throughput; it is not a claim that MI450X is stronger or weaker than MI455X.

evidence.quote: The portfolio spans the AMD Helios™ rackscale solution powered by 72 AMD Instinct MI455X or MI450X GPUs
A full AMD Helios rackscale solution delivers up to 1.4 exaFLOPS of FP8 compute, 2.9 exaFLOPS of FP4 compute and 31 TB of HBM4 memory
Each AMD Instinct MI455X GPU uses next-gen AMD CDNA™ architecture, with 432 GB HBM4 of memory and up to 23.3 TB/s bandwidth

notes.zh:
回答「一个机架能装多少 HBM、给多少 FP8/FP4 算力」，不是单卡规格。官方写的 31 TB 是 72 张 MI455X 的合计；1.4 EF FP8 与 2.9 EF FP4 也是整机架数字。采购时先确认是 72 张 MI455X 还是 MI450X 配置，两者单卡显存不同。
不主张：不是单芯片性能比较；不是「买到就能跑满」的保证；整机功耗、冷却与机房条件另算。
notes.en:
Answers how much HBM and FP8/FP4 compute one rack holds, not a single card. The official 31 TB is the sum of 72 MI455X GPUs; 1.4 EF FP8 and 2.9 EF FP4 are rack-level figures too. Confirm whether the configuration is 72 MI455X or MI450X — their per-card memory differs.
It does not claim: a single-chip comparison; a guarantee that buying the rack means running at peak; power, cooling and facility constraints are separate.

evidence.quote: Dedicated Memory Size 64 GB  Dedicated Memory Type HBM2e

notes.zh: 回答上一代 PCIe 形态加速卡的显存与带宽档位，常见于存量服务器升级场景。该页未给整板功耗，按「查不到留空」处理。注意它是被动散热、全高双槽，装机前要确认机箱风道能压住。
notes.en: Answers the memory and bandwidth tier of a previous-generation PCIe accelerator, typically relevant when upgrading existing servers. The page lists no board power, so that field is left empty rather than guessed. It is passively cooled in a full-height double-slot form, so chassis airflow must be confirmed before installation.

specs.form factor: PCIe add-in card, full height, double slot, 267 mm

notes.zh: 回答单卡显存容量与带宽的量级，供「一个模型能不能整卡装下」这类判断使用。不回答软件栈成熟度或迁移成本：该页只给硬件规格，ROCm 支持范围与框架版本需另查官方文档。
notes.en: Answers the order of magnitude of per-card memory and bandwidth, which is what a "does this model fit on one card" decision needs. It does not answer software-stack maturity or porting cost: the page carries hardware figures only, so ROCm coverage and framework versions must be checked against the vendor documentation.

evidence.quote: p5.48xlarge  192  2 TiB  8 H100  640 GB   HBM3   3200 Gbps EFA

notes.zh: 回答云上单实例的卡数、总显存、网络与本地盘口径，用来估算多卡训练要不要自己买机器。不回答价格与可用区库存：云报价随时变动且随区域不同，需在官方计费页现查。同页还有 P5e 与 P5en（H200 机型），选型时不要混用两代的数字。
notes.en: Answers the card count, aggregate memory, network and local storage of a single cloud instance, which is what a rent-versus-buy decision rests on. It does not answer price or regional availability: cloud pricing changes and differs per region, so the billing page must be checked at the time. The same page also lists P5e and P5en (H200 machines); figures from the two generations should not be mixed.

evidence.quote: p5.4xlarge  16  256 GiB  1 H100  80 GB   HBM3   100 Gbps EFA
GPUDirect RDMA is not supported in P5.4xlarge

notes.zh: 回答单卡云实例的规格，用于小规模微调或单模型部署。两个容易忽略的限制：单卡实例不支持 GPUDirect RDMA，也没有 NVSwitch，想靠多台单卡机拼出多卡训练会卡在通信上；要 8 卡全互联得换 p5.48xlarge。
notes.en: Answers the specification of a single-GPU cloud instance for small fine-tunes or single-model deployment. Two limits are easy to miss: the single-card size supports neither GPUDirect RDMA nor NVSwitch, so stitching several single-GPU hosts into a multi-card training job is communication-bound; eight-card fabric requires the p5.48xlarge size instead.

evidence.quote: 3.2 Tbps of interconnect bandwidth per VM

notes.zh: 回答云上 8 卡 H100 实例的 CPU、内存与互联配置，可与同类实例逐项对照。关键差异在 CPU 与内存配比：本实例 96 vCPU / 1900 GiB，同类其他厂商给到 192 vCPU / 2 TiB，数据加载型任务会先撞 CPU 与内存，而不是 GPU。不回答价格与配额。
notes.en: Answers the CPU, memory and interconnect configuration of an 8-GPU H100 cloud instance so it can be compared item by item with peers. The decisive difference is the CPU-to-memory ratio: this instance pairs 96 vCPUs with 1,900 GiB where a comparable offering provides 192 vCPUs and 2 TiB, so data-loading workloads hit CPU and memory limits before the GPUs. It does not answer price or quota.

specs.networking: 8 NICs; 3.2 Tbps interconnect per VM; 400 Gbps InfiniBand per GPU

evidence.quote: Net Mass/Weight (Spot with battery) 33.8 kg (74.5 lb)

notes.zh: 回答工业巡检型四足的尺寸、防护与地形能力，重点在 IP54 与 -20 至 55°C 的工况范围，这是它区别于轻量科研机型的地方。不回答自主导航能到什么程度：官方页面只给感知视场与测距，自主性取决于所配软件与载荷。
notes.en: Answers the dimensions, ingress protection and terrain capability of an industrial inspection quadruped, where IP54 and a -20 to 55 °C operating range are what distinguish it from lightweight research platforms. It does not answer how far autonomy goes: the page gives perception field of view and range only, and autonomy depends on the software and payload fitted.

specs.dimensions: 1100 mm L x 500 mm W; 610 mm default walking height
specs.terrain sensing: 360° horizontal field of view, 4 m range, works above 2 lux

evidence.quote: Unprecedented AI compute power of 26 Tera-Operations Per Second (TOPS)
The Hailo-8 Industrial Version IC is replacing the discontinued Hailo-8 Commercial Version IC.

notes.zh: 回答低功耗视觉推理模块的算力与功耗档位：片上自带内存、不需要外挂 DRAM 是它区别于大算力卡的关键约束。不回答它能跑哪些大语言模型：官方定位为视觉与神经网络推理，选型前要核对模型是否在支持列表内。商用版本芯片已由官方公告停产、改由工业版本替代，采购时需确认版本。
notes.en: Answers the compute and power tier of a low-power vision inference module, whose defining constraint is on-chip memory with no external DRAM. It does not answer which large language models it can run: the vendor positions it for vision and neural-network inference, so model support must be checked against the supported list first. The vendor has announced end-of-life for the commercial version IC, replaced by the industrial version, so the variant must be confirmed when ordering.

specs.memory: integrated on-chip, no external DRAM required
specs.frameworks: TensorFlow, TensorFlow Lite, Keras, PyTorch, ONNX

evidence.quote: 400W TDP for standard configuration. HGX A100-80GB custom thermal solution (CTS) SKU can support TDPs up to 500W

notes.zh: 回答上一代数据中心卡的显存、带宽与功耗基线，常被当作对照参照。不回答它相对新一代卡的性价比：同在售的 HGX CTS 定制散热机型功耗上限不同，本页把标准 400W 与 500W 上限分开记。
notes.en: Answers the memory, bandwidth and power baseline of the previous data-centre generation, often used as a reference point. It does not answer value-for-money against newer cards: the HGX CTS custom-thermal SKU carries a different ceiling, so the standard 400 W and the 500 W ceiling are recorded separately.

specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 10 GB each

evidence.quote: Tensor Performance1 Up to 1 PFLOP FP4
System Memory 64 GB LPDDR5X* or 128 GB LPDDR5x, coherent unified system memory

notes.zh: 回答桌面级统一内存机器的内存、功耗与体积：128GB 统一内存是它和消费级显卡的根本差别，模型不必先切进显存。官方给出的「最多 200B 参数」是推理口径、且为厂商声明，不是实测；多机互联最多 4 台。不回答训练可行性：微调上限官方写作 70B 参数级。
notes.en: Answers the memory, power and footprint of a desktop unified-memory machine: 128 GB of coherent memory is what separates it from consumer graphics cards, since the model need not be staged into dedicated VRAM first. The stated "up to 200B parameters" is an inference figure and a vendor claim rather than a measurement, and at most four units can be linked. It does not answer training feasibility: the vendor puts fine-tuning at up to 70B parameters.

evidence.quote: Memory Size 24 GB Memory Type GDDR6X

notes.zh: 回答消费级单卡跑本地模型时的显存上限、整卡功耗与整机电源要求。不回答多卡并联能力：该型号官方标注不支持 NVLink，多卡只能走 PCIe，实际可用显存仍以单卡为界。
notes.en: Answers the memory ceiling, board power and system power supply requirement when running local models on a consumer card. It does not answer multi-card scaling: the vendor lists no NVLink support for this model, so cards communicate over PCIe only and usable memory stays bounded by a single card.

evidence.quote: Max Thermal Design Power (TDP) Up to 700W (configurable) 350-400W (configurable)

notes.zh: 回答数据中心训练与推理卡的显存容量、带宽、功耗与互联口径。不回答实际训练吞吐或单位算力价格：这里记的是官方规格表数字，且带稀疏标注，实测吞吐随框架、精度与模型结构变化。
notes.en: Answers the memory capacity, bandwidth, power and interconnect figures of a data-centre training and inference card. It does not answer real training throughput or price per unit of compute: these are vendor spec-sheet numbers with sparsity, and measured throughput varies with framework, precision and model shape.

specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 10 GB each

evidence.quote: Max Thermal Design Power (TDP) Up to 700W (configurable) Up to 600W (configurable)
2- or 4-way NVIDIA NVLink bridge: 900GB/s per GPU

notes.zh: 回答 PCIe 风冷形态的 141GB 卡能怎么组：功耗上限低于 SXM 版本，适合低功耗风冷机架。关键约束是互联——NVLink 桥只支持 2 路或 4 路，凑不出 SXM 那种 8 卡全互联，多卡训练要按 PCIe 与桥接拓扑重新估算通信开销。
notes.en: Answers how the 141 GB card can be assembled in a PCIe air-cooled form: its power ceiling is below the SXM variant, which suits lower-power air-cooled racks. The binding constraint is interconnect — the NVLink bridge covers only 2-way or 4-way, so it cannot reproduce the 8-way fabric of SXM and multi-card training must be re-estimated against a PCIe and bridge topology.

specs.interconnect: 2- or 4-way NVLink bridge at 900 GB/s per GPU; PCIe Gen5 128 GB/s
specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 16.5 GB each

evidence.quote: Max Thermal Design Power (TDP) Up to 700W (configurable)
Preliminary specifications. May be subject to change.

notes.zh: 回答与 H100 同功耗档、显存翻到 141GB 的卡是什么水平，用于判断「模型能不能整卡放下」。注意官方在该页标注规格为初步数据、可能变动，采购前须回到最新 datasheet 复核。不回答实际推理吞吐：页面上的加速倍数来自厂商特定 batch 与序列长度条件。
notes.en: Answers what a card at the same power tier as H100 but with 141 GB of memory represents, which is what a "does the model fit on one card" decision needs. The vendor marks these figures as preliminary and subject to change on this page, so the current datasheet must be re-checked before procurement. It does not answer measured inference throughput: the speed-up multiples on the page come from specific vendor batch sizes and sequence lengths.

specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 18 GB each

evidence.quote: Jetson AGX Orin modules deliver up to 275 TOPS of AI performance with power configurable between 15W and 60W.

notes.zh: 回答机器人本体上「板端能跑多大模型」的内存与算力上限。不回答实际帧率：TOPS 是官方标称口径，真实推理速度取决于量化方式、输入分辨率与散热条件，需要实测才有结论。
notes.en: Answers the on-board memory and compute ceiling that decides how large a model a robot body can run. It does not answer real frame rates: TOPS is a vendor rating, and actual inference speed depends on quantisation, input resolution and thermal headroom, which only measurement can settle.

evidence.quote: Jetson Orin NX modules deliver up to 100 TOPS of AI performance in the smallest Jetson form factor, with power configurable between 10W and 25W.

notes.zh: 回答中等算力板端模组的算力、内存与功耗三角：比 AGX Orin 64GB 少约三分之二算力和四分之三内存，功耗却从 60W 级降到 25W 级。不回答散热方案：SO-DIMM 形态要靠载板设计导热，实际能否持续跑满取决于外壳与风道。
notes.en: Answers the compute, memory and power triangle of a mid-tier on-board module: roughly a third of the AGX Orin 64GB compute and a quarter of its memory, but a 25 W class envelope instead of 60 W. It does not answer thermal design: a SO-DIMM module conducts heat through the carrier board, so sustained clocks depend on enclosure and airflow.

evidence.quote: FP32 91.6 teraFLOPS TF32 Tensor Core 366 teraFLOPS* FP16 733 teraFLOPS* FP8 1,466 teraFLOPS* RT Core Performance 212 teraFLOPS Max Power Consumption 350W

notes.zh: 回答一张兼顾图形与推理的 PCIe 卡的算力档位与功耗上限。不回答显存类型与带宽：官方该页只给容量、未给颗粒类型与带宽数值，按「查不到留空」处理，需要时查其 datasheet。
notes.en: Answers the compute tier and power ceiling of a PCIe card that covers both graphics and inference. It does not answer memory type or bandwidth: the vendor page states capacity only, so those fields are left empty rather than guessed, and should be read from the datasheet when needed.

evidence.quote: GPU Memory 48GB GDDR6 with error-correcting code (ECC)

notes.zh: 回答工作站单卡的 48GB 档位：与消费卡同容量的区别在 ECC 显存与 300W 功耗上限，更适合长时间满载与多卡并排。不回答多卡训练效率：该卡同样没有 NVLink，多卡只能走 PCIe，张量并行会受带宽限制。
notes.en: Answers the 48 GB tier for workstation cards: what separates it from a consumer card of the same capacity is ECC memory and a 300 W ceiling, which suits sustained load and side-by-side installation. It does not answer multi-card training efficiency: this card also lacks NVLink, so cards communicate over PCIe and tensor parallelism is bandwidth-bound.

specs.form factor: 4.4 in H x 10.5 in L, dual-slot, active cooling

notes.zh: 回答中距激光雷达的测距、垂直视场与点频档位，用来判断感知方案的量级。不回答功耗与接口：该产品页未给这两项口径，按「查不到留空」处理，选型时需查其 datasheet。「90 m」是在 10% 反射率条件下的测距，深色或远距离目标会显著缩短。
notes.en: Answers the range, vertical field of view and point rate of a mid-range lidar, which is what sets the order of magnitude of a perception setup. It does not answer power draw or interface: the product page gives neither, so those are left empty rather than guessed and should come from the datasheet. The 90 m figure is at 10% reflectivity, so dark or distant targets shorten it substantially.

evidence.quote: Broadcom BCM2712 2.4GHz quad-core 64-bit Arm Cortex-A76 CPU, with Cryptographic Extension, 512KB per-core L2 caches, and a 2MB shared L3 cache
5V/5A DC power via USB-C, with Power Delivery support

notes.zh: 回答边缘小主机的 CPU、内存档位、PCIe 通道与供电口径，用来判断能不能带得动一块加速模块。不回答它自身的 AI 算力：板载没有 NPU，要接 M.2 或 HAT 形态的加速器才具备推理加速能力。官方给出的量产承诺到 2036 年 1 月，做长期项目时可据此评估供货周期。
notes.en: Answers the CPU, memory tiers, PCIe lane and power figures of a small edge host, which is what decides whether it can carry an accelerator module. It does not answer its own AI throughput: there is no on-board NPU, so inference acceleration requires an M.2 or HAT accelerator. The vendor states production until at least January 2036, which is the figure to use when judging supply for a long-lived project.

specs.PCIe: 2.0 x1 (needs separate M.2 HAT or adapter)
specs.power: 5V/5A DC via USB-C; 27 W PSU recommended
specs.network: Gigabit Ethernet (PoE+ via separate HAT); dual-band 802.11ac

title.zh: 宇树 G1 人形机器人

notes.zh: 回答人形本体的尺寸、重量、自由度与续航档位，用来判断它适合哪类实验与场地。不收录价格：报价属商业信息且随时变动，采购需向厂商确认。控制栈与训练框架不属本站范围，见 tools 与 learn 的机器人条目。
notes.en: Answers the size, weight, degrees of freedom and endurance tier of a humanoid body, which is what decides the kind of experiments and floor space it suits. Price is deliberately excluded: quotations are commercial information that changes, and must be confirmed with the vendor. Control stacks and training frameworks are out of scope here and live in the robotics entries of tools and learn.

specs.dimensions: 1320 x 450 x 200 mm standing; 690 x 450 x 300 mm folded
specs.compute: 8-core CPU base; higher-power module optional on EDU

title.zh: 宇树 Go2 四足机器人

evidence.quote: Max Running Speed  Approx. 5m/s  (tested in lab)

notes.zh: 回答四足本体的重量、载荷、续航与感知配置，用来判断场地与实验类型。注意三个容易误读的地方：5m/s 是实验室条件；续航 1–4 小时随机型与电池容量变化；工作最大功率约 3000W 属瞬时峰值，不能按此推算平均供电。价格不收录。
notes.en: Answers the weight, payload, endurance and perception setup of a quadruped body, which is what decides the floor space and experiment type it suits. Three figures are easy to misread: 5 m/s is a laboratory figure; endurance ranges from 1 to 4 hours depending on variant and battery; and the ~3000 W working maximum is a transient peak that must not be used to size average power. Price is excluded.

specs.payload: about 7-8 kg (max 10-12 kg depending on variant)
specs.endurance: about 1-2 h; 2-4 h with long-endurance battery
specs.perception: 4D LiDAR L2, 360° x 96°, minimum detection 0.05 m; HD wide-angle camera

evidence.quote: GPU Memory | 1,440 GB total, 64 TB/s HBM3e bandwidth

notes.zh: 八卡 Blackwell 整机，回答「一台机器能装多少 HBM、能给出多少 FP4 算力」。1,440 GB 是整机合计，不是单卡；FP4 数字不能与 FP16/BF16 直接横比。约 14.3 kW 的整机功耗意味着供电、散热与机房条件要先落实，再谈采购。
notes.en: An eight-GPU Blackwell system that answers how much HBM one machine holds and how much FP4 compute it delivers. The 1,440 GB figure is the whole system, not one GPU, and FP4 numbers are not directly comparable with FP16/BF16. At roughly 14.3 kW, power, cooling and facility constraints must be settled before purchase.

notes.zh: 机架级系统：36 颗 Grace CPU 加 72 颗 Blackwell GPU，组成一个 72 卡 NVLink 域。它回答的是「一个机架能否当一台大机器用」，不是单卡规格。采购要连液冷、供电与整架网络一起算；另注意 NVIDIA 页面写 13.4 TB HBM3E，Azure 同代整架写 13.5 TB，引用时必须注明来源口径。
notes.en: A rack-scale system: 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs form one 72-GPU NVLink domain. It answers whether a rack can act as one large machine, not what one card looks like. Purchase includes liquid cooling, power and fabric. Note that NVIDIA lists 13.4 TB HBM3E while Azure lists 13.5 TB for the same rack generation; always state the source.

notes.zh: 消费级 Blackwell 卡，32 GB GDDR7 与 1,792 GB/s 让它成为单机跑 4-bit 30B 级模型的常见选择。575 W 卡功耗与 1,000 W 系统电源是装机门槛；没有 NVLink，多卡并行只能走 PCIe，扩展性不如专业卡。
notes.en: A consumer Blackwell card. Its 32 GB GDDR7 and 1,792 GB/s make it a common choice for running 4-bit 30B-class models on one machine. The 575 W board and 1,000 W system power are installation constraints, and without NVLink multi-GPU scaling goes over PCIe.

evidence.quote: Jetson Thor series modules deliver up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS of AI compute and 128 GB of memory

notes.zh: 机器人/边缘平台：128 GB 统一内存但只有 273 GB/s 带宽，容量大、带宽窄，适合 7B–30B 级模型 4-bit 常驻。40–130 W 的功耗窗口意味着持续推理会降频；2070 TFLOPS 是 FP4 稀疏口径，不能与数据中心卡的 FP16 数字直接比。
notes.en: A robotics and edge platform: 128 GB unified memory but only 273 GB/s bandwidth, so capacity is large while bandwidth is narrow. It suits persistent 4-bit 7B–30B models. The 40–130 W window means sustained inference throttles, and 2070 TFLOPS is FP4 sparse, not comparable with data-centre FP16 figures.

evidence.quote: customers can access up to 72 Blackwell GPUs within one NVLink domain
360 petaflops of FP8 compute (without sparsity) and 13.4 TB of total high- bandwidth memory (HBM3e)
130 terabytes per second of low-latency NVLink connectivity between GPUs

notes.zh: 云上租一整个 72 卡 NVLink 域，不是租单卡；360 PFLOPS 是 FP8 无稀疏口径，13.4 TB 是域内 HBM 合计。适合万亿参数级训练与推理；本站不采价格，预算要按 AWS 官方定价页另算。与 P5en 相比，AWS 声称算力 20 倍、显存 11 倍、NVLink 聚合带宽 15 倍。
notes.en: Rents a whole 72-GPU NVLink domain rather than a single card. 360 PFLOPS is FP8 without sparsity and 13.4 TB is aggregate HBM in the domain. It targets trillion-parameter training and inference; this site does not collect prices, so budget from the official AWS pricing page. AWS claims 20x compute, 11x memory and 15x aggregate NVLink bandwidth versus P5en.

specs.GPU 数 / GPUs: up to 72 Blackwell GPUs per UltraServer

evidence.quote: P6-B200 instances provide 8x NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with 1440 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory

notes.zh: 单机 8 卡 Blackwell 的云实例，比 P6e 小一档；1,432 GB 是实例内 8 卡 HBM 合计。3.2 Tb/s 是节点网络上限，跨节点训练仍要看集群网络。页面同时给出 1,440 GB 与表格里的 1,432 GB 两种口径，本站按表格逐实例数字记录并注明差异。
notes.en: An eight-GPU Blackwell cloud instance, one tier below P6e; 1,432 GB is aggregate HBM across the eight GPUs. 3.2 Tb/s is the node network ceiling and cross-node training still depends on cluster fabric. The page gives both 1,440 GB and 1,432 GB in its table; this card records the per-instance table figure and notes the discrepancy.

evidence.quote: AWS Trainium2 芯片的性能是第一代 Trainium 的 4 倍。
Trn2 实例采用多达 16 个 Trainium2 芯片，Trn2 UltraServer 采用多达 64 个 Trainium2 芯片，这些芯片使用我们专有的芯片间互连技术 NeuronLink 进行互连。
与基于 GPU 的 EC2 P5e 和 P5en 实例相比，它们的性价比提高了 30% 到 40%。

notes.zh: AWS 自研训练加速器，第二代；单实例最多 16 颗，UltraServer 最多 64 颗，用 NeuronLink 互联。软件栈是 AWS Neuron，不是 CUDA，迁移成本要单列。页面没有给 Trainium2 单芯片 HBM 容量，本站留空不猜；同页的 Trainium3 是下一代（144 GB HBM3e、4.9 TB/s），不要把两代数字混在一张卡里。
notes.en: AWS’s second-generation in-house training accelerator: up to 16 chips per instance and 64 per UltraServer, linked by NeuronLink. The software stack is AWS Neuron, not CUDA, so migration cost is a separate line item. The page does not list per-chip HBM for Trainium2, so this card leaves it blank rather than guessing; Trainium3 on the same page is a different generation (144 GB HBM3e, 4.9 TB/s).

specs.芯片数 / chips: up to 16 per Trn2 instance; up to 64 per Trn2 UltraServer

evidence.quote: Each ND-GB200-v6 VM is powered by two NVIDIA Grace CPUs and four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.
The GPUs are interconnected via fifth-generation NVLink, providing a total of 4× 1.8 TB/s NVLink bandwidth per VM.
Accelerators | 4 GPUs | Nvidia Blackwell GPU (192 GiB)

notes.zh: Azure 以 4 卡 VM 为售卖单位；18 台 VM 组成一个 72 卡的 GB200 NVL72 域。192 GiB 是每卡显存，不要乘成 VM 总量。选型要同时看单 VM 的 4×1.8 TB/s NVLink 与整域的 130 TB/s 横截面带宽；跨 VM 仍走 InfiniBand。
notes.en: Azure sells this as a four-GPU VM; 18 VMs form a 72-GPU GB200 NVL72 domain. 192 GiB is per GPU, not per VM. Selection must look at both the VM’s 4x 1.8 TB/s NVLink and the domain’s 130 TB/s cross-section, with cross-VM traffic over InfiniBand.

evidence.quote: Four trillion transistors. 250 petaflops. One silicon wafer.
The Cerebras CS-4 rack-scale AI system is powered by three WSE-3T processors

notes.zh:
回答「晶圆级芯片单片的晶体管、面积、核心数与官方 AI 算力口径」。250 PF 是官方“AI compute”表述，未注明是 dense FP16 还是特定精度，不能直接和 GPU 的 FP16/FP8 数字横比。
不主张：不是单卡 PCIe 加速器；不是 CS-4 整机算力；未公开对外售价与功耗口径。
notes.en:
Answers the transistor count, die area, core count and the vendor's "AI compute" figure for one wafer-scale chip. 250 PF is the vendor's AI-compute wording, not labelled as dense FP16 or a specific precision, so it is not directly comparable with GPU FP16/FP8 numbers.
It does not claim: this is not a PCIe add-in card; it is not the CS-4 system figure; price and power are not stated here.

specs.系统形态: CS-4 机架系统（3 颗 WSE-3T）

evidence.quote: Each Inferentia2 accelerator supports up to 190 tera floating operations per second (TFLOPS) of FP16 performance.
Inferentia2 offers 32 GB of HBM per accelerator
Each Inferentia2 accelerator has two second-generation NeuronCores
with up to 12 Inferentia2 accelerators per EC2 Inf2 instance

notes.zh:
回答「Inferentia2 单加速器的 FP16 算力、HBM 容量与 Inf2 实例上限」。190 TFLOPS 是 FP16；32GB HBM 是单卡容量；12 卡是 Inf2 实例上限，不是单机默认配置。
不主张：不是训练芯片（训练看 Trainium）；不是通用 GPU；实际吞吐取决于 Neuron 编译、批处理与模型结构。
notes.en:
Answers the per-accelerator FP16 compute, HBM capacity and the Inf2 instance ceiling. 190 TFLOPS is FP16; 32GB HBM is per accelerator; 12 accelerators is the Inf2 instance maximum, not a default configuration.
It does not claim: this is not a training chip (see Trainium); it is not a general-purpose GPU; real throughput depends on Neuron compilation, batching and model shape.

evidence.quote: Up to 2x AI compute (FP8) vs. Intel Gaudi 2 AI Accelerators
Up to 4x AI compute (BF16) vs. Intel Gaudi 2 AI Accelerators
Intel® Gaudi® 3 accelerator (1200 GB/s open standard RoCE)
Intel Gaudi® 3 PCIe card (HL-338) delivers AI acceleration in a standard PCIe Gen5 form factor

notes.zh:
回答「Gaudi 3 相对上一代的算力代际、I/O 与形态」。官方产品页只给相对倍数（FP8 2×、BF16 4×）与 1200 GB/s RoCE；绝对 HBM/TOPS 未在这页给出，本站不补推测数字。
不主张：不是 GPU；不是只有 PCIe 卡（还有 OAM/UBB 形态）；相对倍数不能跨代直接换算成绝对算力。
notes.en:
Answers the generational compute step, I/O and form factor. The product page gives relative figures only (FP8 2x, BF16 4x) and 1200 GB/s RoCE; absolute HBM/TOPS are not stated here and are not guessed.
It does not claim: this is not a GPU; it is not PCIe-only (OAM/UBB variants exist); relative multiples cannot be converted into absolute compute across generations.

evidence.quote: 每个芯片的峰值计算能力 (bf16) | 197 TFLOPs
HBM2 容量和带宽 | 16 GB，819 GBps
双向芯片间互连 (ICI) 带宽（每芯片） | 400 GBps
TPU Pod 大小 | 256 个芯片

notes.zh:
回答「v5e 单芯片的 BF16 算力、HBM、ICI 与 Pod 规模」。197 TFLOPS 是 BF16 峰值；16GB HBM2 / 819 GB/s 是单芯片；256 芯片是 Pod 上限。
不主张：不是 v5p 或 v6e；不是单卡零售产品；实际训练/推理吞吐取决于拓扑、批量与框架。
notes.en:
Answers per-chip BF16 compute, HBM, ICI and Pod size. 197 TFLOPS is BF16 peak; 16GB HBM2 / 819 GB/s is per chip; 256 chips is the Pod ceiling.
It does not claim: this is not v5p or v6e; it is not a retail add-in card; real throughput depends on topology, batching and framework.

evidence.quote: 每个芯片的峰值计算能力 (bf16) | 197 TFLOPs | 918 TFLOPs
每个芯片的 HBM 容量 | 16 GB | 32 GB
每个芯片的 HBM 带宽 | 800 GBps | 1600 GBps
每个 Pod 的 BF16 峰值计算能力 | 50.63 PFLOPs | 234.9 PFLOPs

notes.zh:
回答「v6e 相对 v5e 的单芯片 BF16、HBM、带宽与 Pod 算力」。918 TFLOPS 是 BF16 峰值；32GB HBM / 1600 GB/s 是单芯片；234.9 PFLOPS 是 256 芯片 Pod 的 BF16 峰值。
不主张：不是 v7/Ironwood；不是单卡；Pod 数字不是单机数字。
notes.en:
Answers v6e versus v5e per-chip BF16, HBM, bandwidth and Pod compute. 918 TFLOPS is BF16 peak; 32GB HBM / 1600 GB/s is per chip; 234.9 PFLOPS is the BF16 peak of a 256-chip Pod.
It does not claim: this is not v7/Ironwood; it is not a single add-in card; the Pod figure is not a single-host figure.

evidence.quote: Peak Eight-bit Precision (FP8) Performance (E5M2, E4M3) 2.61 PFLOPs

notes.zh:
回答「MI325X 的 256GB HBM3E、6TB/s 带宽、FP8 2.61 PF 与 1000W 峰值功耗」。FP8 2.61 PF 是 dense；5.22 PF 是结构化稀疏，不能混读。
不主张：不是 MI300X（容量与带宽不同）；不是 MI355X；实际功耗与集群配置相关。
notes.en:
Answers MI325X's 256GB HBM3E, 6TB/s bandwidth, 2.61 PF FP8 and 1000W peak power. 2.61 PF FP8 is dense; 5.22 PF is structured sparsity and must not be mixed.
It does not claim: this is not MI300X (different capacity/bandwidth); it is not MI355X; real power depends on the system.

notes.zh:
回答「H100 NVL 的 94GB HBM3、3.9TB/s、FP16 1,671 TF 与 350–400W」。1,671 TF 是带稀疏的 FP16 Tensor Core 数字；dense 需按官方脚注折算。
不主张：不是 H100 SXM（80GB / 3.35TB/s / 700W）；不是 H200；不是整机 8 卡数字。
notes.en:
Answers H100 NVL's 94GB HBM3, 3.9TB/s, 1,671 TF FP16 and 350–400W. 1,671 TF is the sparse FP16 Tensor Core figure; dense needs the official footnote conversion.
It does not claim: this is not H100 SXM (80GB / 3.35TB/s / 700W); it is not H200; it is not an 8-GPU system figure.

notes.zh:
回答「工作站版 RTX PRO 6000 的 96GB GDDR7 ECC、1792 GB/s、4000 AI TOPS 与 600W」。4000 TOPS 是 FP4 稀疏口径，不是 FP16 dense。
不主张：不是数据中心 B200/GB200；不是 Max-Q 或服务器版；不是多卡整机数字。
notes.en:
Answers the workstation RTX PRO 6000's 96GB GDDR7 ECC, 1792 GB/s, 4000 AI TOPS and 600W. 4000 TOPS is FP4 sparse, not FP16 dense.
It does not claim: this is not a data-center B200/GB200; it is not the Max-Q or server variant; it is not a multi-GPU system figure.

evidence.quote: We pioneered the LPU. Now, with LPX, it works alongside NVIDIA’s next-generation GPUs to deliver unparalleled inference capability

notes.zh:
回答「Groq 的 LPU/LPX 是什么定位：面向推理的专用处理器与推理云」。官方首页没有给出单芯片 SRAM、带宽、TFLOPS 等完整规格，本站不填未核数字；需要精确规格时查官方产品页/技术文档。
不主张：不是通用 GPU；不是训练芯片；不是单卡零售产品；LPX 与 NVIDIA GPU 的搭配关系不代表性能等价。
notes.en:
Answers what Groq's LPU/LPX is positioned as: an inference-specific processor and inference cloud. The homepage does not publish complete per-chip SRAM, bandwidth or TFLOPS figures, so no unverified numbers are filled in; check the official product/technical docs for exact specs.
It does not claim: this is not a general-purpose GPU; not a training chip; not a retail add-in card; the LPX + NVIDIA pairing does not imply performance equivalence.

specs.定位: 推理专用 LPU / 推理云
